title: Temporary (spell flag)
html:
Temporary is a spell flag. Actions with this flag are placed in a dedicated section of the hotbar on the right-hand side. This flag is generally used for actions temporarily granted by spells and conditions such as recastable spells like  Activate Call Lightning.
